bluejetty:00082706:ios.description:
Unlock the power of intermittent fasting to reach your goal weight and get healthy. No diet and no yo-yo effect. Improve your metabolic health and feel full of energy.
What is intermittent fasting?
Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular health and fitness trends. Instead of a diet, it's an eating pattern that cycles between periods of fasting and eating. It doesn't specify which foods you should eat or avoid, but when you should eat.
Today, we eat 3–4 (or more) meals per day, and never feel hungry. This requires our organs to work hard all the time, and never take a break from digesting. Our eating habits may result in obesity and health problems, such as diabetes.
When fasting, your body will detoxify, burn fat and regenerate. After a few weeks, you'll feel healthier and more active. 
Gradual fasting plans, suitable for all! 
Create your own fasting plan 13-11, 15-9, 16-10, 16-8, 18-6, 20-4, 23-1, 24, 36, 48, Custom
5+2 Weekly Plan : During the week, eat normally for 5 days, and choose another 2 days for a little control.Women take 500Kcal and men take 600Kcal on fasting days. You can choose to take it all at once, but a better choice is to divide 600Kcal into two meals, 250Kcal for breakfast and 350Kcal for dinner. The food should preferably be some food with high protein content but low glycemic index (GI). It is not recommended to completely eliminate carbohydrates. When eating, chew slowly and savor well. The fasting days need to be separated, such as Monday and Thursday. This light fasting plan is healthy, effective and easy to implement, allowing you to lose weight easily while enjoying the other benefits of fasting. It can be performed long-term, gradually turning it into a healthy lifestyle.
16-8 is the most popular fasting plan for weight loss. With 16 hours fasting period, your body will gradually get used to fasting. 
Body Status Tracker : 
Blood Sugar Rises 
Blood Sugar Falls 
Glycogen Reserve Drops 
Ketosis State 
More Features : 
- Track your weight changes 
- BMI(kg/m²) 
- Water tracker 
- Drink water reminder 
- On 'Record' Page, you can click 'Start' in the 'Daily Steps' card to read step count data from Apple Health
Privacy Policy : https://wowfitness.github.io/Privacy-Policy/ 
Terms of Use : https://wowfitness.github.io/Terms-of-Use/

bluejetty:00019140:ios.description:
Horror Clown is a horror game. In this game, you play as Bill - the captain of Loser's Club. After 27 years, clown has come back. He kidnapped all of Bill's friends. You must go to the house of horror clown to save them.
The evil clown is the embodiment of an ancient evil creature. The clown had its original shape as a yellow light called death light, existing in the Macro Universe (Macroverse), arriving at Earth for a long time. This creature possesses magical power, which has the ability to change its shape to whoever it wants.
Every 27 years,the evil clown wakes up after a long hibernation and looks for food. The clown especially likes to eat children, so the image of the clown is chosen to appear and scare the children. However, the horror clown does not swallow the prey immediately but "eats fear" from the victim. He likes to manipulate the minds of children with wounds or tragedies.
KEY FEATURES
Hide
The object in your environment could be your salvation. Clown can’t see you cowering in the closet or under the bed! 
Solve puzzles
Try to figure out the cause of this ghoulish chaos and complete terrifying quests!
Listen
Listen carefully to your surroundings, every stray noise could completely change the situation.
Survive
Just one wrong move could be the death of you.

Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Greek.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Greek empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Greek required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Greek the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Greek so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in greece.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Greek.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!

bluejetty:00030217:ios.name: Eclipse Yourself: Health Watch
bluejetty:00030217:ios.summary: Eclipse empowers users to understand their individual health journey by monitoring the core health pillars of activity, recovery and readiness. Health monitoring is so much more than tracking numbers and scores. The true value is understand
bluejetty:00030217:ios.description:
Eclipse empowers users to understand their individual health journey by monitoring the core health pillars of activity, recovery and readiness. Health monitoring is so much more than tracking numbers and scores. The true value is understanding your balance at a glance. 
QUALITY GUARANTEED
· From the makers of world leading apps AutoSleep & HeartWatch, this is the one app that brings all our expertise together - designed to unlock the true power of your Apple Watch.
· Eclipse Yourself has been developed and used by professional sports for years. What was once only available for athletes, has been crafted into a tool for everyone to help enhance your fitness levels, optimise your sleep, and assess your mental and physical readiness.
ACTIVITY - “Are you in your optimal zone, doing too much activity or too little?”
· Regardless of your health goals, everyone has an optimal zone to keep their activity in balance. Eclipse use's this activity data to display a personalised 'Road to Success', so you can see if you are in the optimal zone by building fitness, maintaining, potentially over reaching or even not doing enough.
RECOVERY - “Are you at peak recovery based on your body's needs?”
· Understand the power of sleep and the link to better overall health. Each time we sleep our body recovers, however the quality of our recovery varies.
· Eclipse use's the most important sleep metrics to display a personalised 'Peak Recovery' visual to keep your recovery in balance.
· Recovery requires sleep data from the Apple Sleep app or AutoSleep app.
READINESS - “Are you ready to perform at your best?”
· Readiness can monitor physical fatigue and mental stress, giving insights on when you are ready to perform, and when you should consider your options, such as warning signs for sickness.
· Eclipse use's this data to display a personalised 'Readiness Sunrise' visual to keep your readiness in balance.
· Readiness requires sleep data from the Apple Sleep app or AutoSleep app.
SHARE - "Share your activity levels, recovery status and readiness with other users"
· The most advanced fully integrated Apple Watch sharing platform across groups and squads.
· Compatible on both iPhone and iPad.
· View up to 6 months of data with trends and analysis.
· Sharing permissions allow users to nominate what data they wish to share.
· Secure sharing using your personal iCloud (total privacy and control).
· Setup custom groups and apply filters and views to better monitor your group.
· Sharing is part of the 'Eclipse Yourself + Share' subscription. Sharing is not required for individuals monitoring just their own Eclipse.
· Requires available iCloud storage.
DISCOVER YOURSELF - "Unique functions and insights"
· Widgets for your iPhone.
· Post workout questionnaire.
· Daily wellness survey.
· Watch app & complications.
· Heart rate variability (HRV).
· Sleep duration, fatigue & heart rate.
· Flag injuries & illness.
· Workout intensity.
· Respiration rate.
· Waking pulse.
· Training load.
· Blood oxygen.
· Exports.
· Wrist temperature variance.
· Mental readiness.
· 7 day and 28 day trends.
· Personal bests.
· Pace and distance.
· Charts and quad graphs.
· Effort comparisons.
· Plus much more.
FAMILY SHARING INCLUDED
SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
· Eclipse Yourself is free to download. Ongoing use requires an active subscription, available on a yearly basis.
· You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
· Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
· Subscriptions and auto-renew can be managed by the user by going to the App Store 'Manage Subscriptions' settings page.
· Read our Privacy Policy and User Terms: https://eclipse.tantsissa.com/support/privacy

Phần mềm cho phép người sử dụng cập nhật các thông tin mới nhất về thị trường tài chính, chứng khoán, theo dõi các cổ phiếu quan tâm, những thống kê chuyên sâu, tin tức... Phần mềm cũng cung cấp nhiều công cụ cho phép nhà đầu tư phân tích, tìm kiếm cơ hội đầu tư trên thị trường.
FireAnt Mobile bao gồm nhiều tính năng ưu việt như:
- Hệ thống tin tức hiển thị khoa học, được sắp xếp hợp lý giúp người xem dễ dàng tiếp cận
- Chia sẻ, kết nối, tương tác với nhà đầu tư khác. Theo dõi các chuyên gia hàng đầu trong ngành để được cập nhật những đánh giá, phân tích mới nhất.
- Các khóa học và hội thảo online giúp nâng cao kiến thức, hỗ trợ phát triển tài chính trong tương lai
- Dữ liệu realtime được cập nhật nhanh và ổn định nhất hiện nay. Giá chứng khoán trong và ngoài nước được cập nhật từng giây. Đa dạng các loại hình chứng khoán như cổ phiếu, hợp đồng tương lai, chứng quyền...
- Các thống kê đa chiều về cổ phiếu: Cung cầu, Khớp lệnh,...
- Quản lý Watchlist dễ dàng theo dõi các chứng khoán bạn quan tâm. Tự động nhận push ngay khi có tin tức liên quan tới chứng khoán bạn quan tâm
- Thông tin chi tiết về từng cổ phiếu: Giá, Thông tin tài chính, Cổ đông,...
- Phần mềm phân tích kỹ thuật mạnh mẽ
- Phần mềm bảng giá trực quan, sinh động
- Các công cụ hỗ trợ Lọc cổ phiếu, TOP cổ phiếu,... giúp nhà đầu tư dễ dàng tìm kiếm cơ hội

bluejetty:00069707:ios.description:
Will help you to avoid to avoid bill shocks when you are on internation roaming- with a home screen widget, Apple Watch support and alerts before you hit your carrier's limit. No VPN required.
App shows how much data you've used, how much is left and how many days you can safely use it without hitting your limit.
Works with all network types - 5G, LTE, 4G, 3G, Wi-Fi and international roaming.
REMAINING AT A GLANCE
Monitor Cellular, Wi-Fi and Roaming usage in one place
See Remaining data, Days left and Per-day allowance at a glance
Understand monthly trends with a clear bar graph of your billing periods
Tap any bar to see a color-coded upload vs download breakdown
REAL-TIME · NO VPN · NO SERVER
All monitoring happens on-device using live network interface counters. No VPN profile is installed. No data ever leaves your phone. 100% private, 100% on-device.
DAILY & MONTHLY HISTORY
Track today's and yesterday's usage separately
Review up to the last 6 billing cycles with per-period totals
Quickly spot spikes so you can avoid overages and throttling
HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Add the InternetTracker widget to your Home Screen
See Remaining / Days Left / Per Day plus Today & Yesterday usage without opening the app
Tap the widget to jump straight into the correct mode (Cellular, Wi-Fi or Roaming)
APPLE WATCH
Use Apple Watch complications to see your status at a glance
View your current remaining data and days left on Apple Watch
Check usage while traveling, right from your wrist
Data is synced from your iPhone so your watch always reflects your latest usage
SMART ALERTS
Set your monthly limit and billing cycle day once per bearer (Cellular, Wi-Fi, Roaming)
See a clear status banner: within limit, nearing limit or exceeded
Optional alerts before you hit your configured threshold
ROAMING TRACKER - TRAVELING ABROAD?
Switch to Roaming mode to track international data separately.
Get alerted before you hit your carrier's roaming cap and avoid expensive overage charges.
INTELLIGENT GAP RECOVERY
Didn't open the app for a few days? No problem. The app estimates your usage from raw hardware interface counters and fills in the missing days automatically — so your history stays complete and your monthly total stays accurate.
INTERNET TRACKER PRO
Upgrade to InternetTracker Pro to unlock the full experience:
- Remove all banner ads across the app
- Unlock full Remaining, Daily and Monthly views with complete history
- Enable detailed monthly usage graphs for each data bearer
- Use Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch to check usage instantly
InternetTracker is designed for clarity, not clutter. Whether you're on a strict roaming plan, sharing a hotspot or just want to avoid surprise bills, InternetTracker gives you the numbers that matter - right when you need them.
Enjoying the app? A quick rating helps others find it - thank you!

bluejetty:00015117:ios.description:
Learn 50+ languages with Clozemaster — the gamified language learning app for A2-C1 learners to master vocabulary by filling in missing words in real-world contexts. 
[ MASTER LANGUAGES WITH THE CLOZE TEST METHOD ]
• Level up your language skills with cloze tests, where you fill in the missing word, challenging you to complete sentences. 
• Learn vocabulary in context, moving beyond single-word flashcards to complete sentences drawn from real-life scenarios.
[ CONTEXTUAL LEARNING FOR REAL-WORLD FLUENCY ]
• Experience language as it's used in daily life; learn by completing thousands of sentences in over 50 languages. 
• Progress through sentences sorted by frequency, focusing first on the words you're most likely to use.
[ EXPLORE A WEALTH OF LANGUAGES ]
• Play over 50 languages - Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Breton, Bulgarian, Cantonese, Catalan, Cornish, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English (Ingles), Esperanto, Estonian, Finnish, French, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Guarani, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Interlingue, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Kazakh, Korean, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Lojban, Macedonian, Mandarin Chinese, Maori, Nahuatl, Norwegian, Persian Farsi, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Scottish Gaelic, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish (Español), Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Thai, Toki Pona, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Welsh, Yiddish.
• Each language offers authentic phrases and expressions, enhancing cultural understanding.
[ GAMIFY YOUR LEARNING JOURNEY ]
• Score points for correct answers, competing on a global leaderboard to make learning engaging and rewarding.
• Tackle language challenges to stay motivated, with gamified exercises enhancing your daily learning.
[ TAILOR YOUR LANGUAGE EXPERIENCE ]
• Adjust the speaking speed to match your comprehension level, catering to learners at all stages.
• Visual progress tracking and spaced repetition help you climb the leaderboard and master sentences efficiently.
[ DIVERSE LEARNING MODES FOR A HOLISTIC APPROACH ]
• Engage with three distinct modes - Vocabulary, Listening, and Speaking - to cater to different aspects of language learning.
• Try out the beta feature 'Radio' for a hands-free learning experience, listening to sentences with translations and thoughtful pauses.
[ INTERACTIVE LEARNING SUPPORT ]
• If you answer incorrectly, tap "Explain" for detailed grammar explanations, aiding your understanding and retention.
[ FREE TO PLAY, RICH IN LEARNING ]
• Start your language learning journey for free, with essential features accessible to all users.
• Choose to upgrade to Clozemaster Pro for a more comprehensive and customized learning experience.
[ UNLOCK ADVANCED FEATURES ] 
• Gain unlimited access to advanced learning features and in-depth exercises with the Pro version.
• Create and share custom sentence collections, allowing for a tailored and personalized learning experience.
• Access a vast library of grammar challenges and exclusive content, enhancing your linguistic proficiency.
Download Clozemaster now and transform your approach to language learning. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced learner, Clozemaster offers a unique and effective way to expand your vocabulary and understand the intricacies of over 50 languages. 
• Upon confirming your purchase, the charge will be applied to your Apple account.
• To provide uninterrupted service, subscriptions renew automatically. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage auto-renewal settings anytime by adjusting your preferences in the App Store.
• For a deeper understanding of our policies, please review https://www.clozemaster.com/terms
For support or feedback, contact us at hello@clozemaster.com 
Start your journey to language mastery today!

The app can export scanned documents as PDF and also does text recognition (OCR). You can easily a
bluejetty:00068878:ios.description:
Easy to use scanner. Convert scans into PDF for easy sharing.
*Free version offers 5 scans every month. Upgrade to Pro to remove the limit*
The app can export scanned documents as PDF and also does text recognition (OCR). You can easily access all text content or perhaps just the website address or phone number.
You scanned documents are automatically saved to iCloud Drive and available on all your Apple devices.
iPad version supports drag and drop so you can quickly drag scanned documents to other apps.
| Scan
Scan one or multiple pages and adjust the edges if needed before saving the final scan. The app automatically detects the edges of the document for better experience.
You can rotate the scanned document or apply Grayscale, Black & White or Photo filters. Just make sure to do these edits before confirming the scan.
| Export
Easily share scanned documents as individual images or create PDF from all the pages in one scan.
| iCloud
All scanned documents are automatically uploaded to your iCloud Drive for easy access and backup. Just look for the "Scan it" folder. You can also customize this to export single PDF from multiple scans.
| Text Recognition
Scan it features OCR which means that scanned text will get recognized and you can quickly make use of it. For example if you scan business card you will get tappable links in results allowing you to make a call, send an email, open Safari or maps depending on the contents.
This recognized text can also be easily shared.
Examples where app can help:
* Scan business cards to quickly save contact information like an email or phone number
* Scan receipts to keep track of expenses
* Scan interesting book pages or other articles for later
* Scan and archive invoices and other important documents
* Paper notes, mindmaps and other important texts so you never lose it

To survive, I must win both his heart and his body!

Waking up from death, I see things that seem out of this world!
And a mysterious voice tells me,
“If you want to return to your world, save “Him”

Moreover, the royal palace I suddenly enter is even more “deteriorated” than I thought…

-The cursed but irresistibly charming “King”

- The slightly insane but irresistible “Dark Mage”
“If it’s you, I can offer my purity..”
- The stoic yet deeply romantic “Knight”
“I’m willing to sacrifice my life for your happiness.”
- The handsome “Foreteller” even behind the mask
[Recommended for]
 - Adults seeking high-level, mature stories
 - Fans of reincarnation, regression, and transmigration narratives
 - Arthurian Legends’s Fans
 - Handsome male characters enthusiasts
 - Fantasy romance enthusiasts
 - Players who enjoyed 'Love Pheromone' and 'Eternal Afterlife'

Artista Impresso
bluejetty:00023775:ios.description:
Artista Impresso has been chosen as the official app of the Macy’s® Art in Bloom Flower Show—A Springtime Celebration of Imagination and Creativity! 
Transform your snapshot into a stroke-filled Impressionist masterpiece
Artista Impresso — Passion Filled Impressionism
The 19th century brush-wielding Impressionist artists were crazy about flowers and gardens, and it was good. With flowing brush strokes and thickly painted texture, Van Gogh made his sunflowers immortal; with harmonious movement of color, contrast, and form, Monet made his lily pond a celebrity. It took their genius, lifetimes of practice, and navigating the riot of their senses, but these extraordinary artists took what they saw and felt in the petals and leaves and transferred their impressions onto canvasses full of beauty, mood, and meaning. 
Lucky you, 21st century iPhone-wielding seer and lover of beauty—you have Impresso. With the same enduring attention to detail, light, color, and texure, Impresso transforms your photos into multi-textured, stroke-filled Impressionist masterpieces. And keen eyes will love how Impresso maintains the balance of your piece! The result—captivating, print-worthy paintings brimming with passion, life, and beauty. 
IMPRESSIONISM STYLES
Alla Prima—uses a small brush inside an already placed detail ellipse tool for up-close or full-length portraits and still lifes. Included with this beautiful paint style is a library of artistic finishes to fill the painting with light and color
En Plein Air—creates a stroke-filled landscape using one of the eight color palettes created by famous impressionist artists.
FEATURES 
One-touch settings automatically transform photos into paintings using one of many paint styles.
One-of-a-kind ellipse detail tool renders small brush strokes inside the placed area. A single ellipse can be used for a face or body; or use two or more for the eyes, hands or other objects.
Canvas or Linen texturing—gives realism to brushed paint. Control over texture turns strength down for printing to canvas.
Artista Impresso is a professional painting app created for photographers and artists of all skill levels!
INCLUDES
• Three easy to change brush stroke styles
• Control over detail ellipse tool, canvas strength, artistic finish and painted edge
• Canvas and linen texture
• 8 Impressionist palette styles
• 40 One-touch paint styles
• 70 Artistic finishes
EVERY JIXIPIX PRODUCT FEATURES
• Support for high resolution images and output
• Multiple Undo
• Randomize Button
• Quick Previewing
• Customizable Styles
• Superior customer service
Contact us any time we are committed to your long-term satisfaction!
________________________________________________________
JixiPix turns any photo into a masterpiece. 
The only requirement is art appreciation—we will take care of the rest!
________________________________________________________

Photography | Graphic | Artistic Apps

bluejetty:00070317:ios.summary:
Ferrite is the award-winning app you need for creating podcasts, radio journalism, or other professional voice production work — lectures, speeches, voice-overs and more.
It combines the ease-of-use of a “voice memo” audio recorder, with a
bluejetty:00070317:ios.description:
Ferrite is the award-winning app you need for creating podcasts, radio journalism, or other professional voice production work — lectures, speeches, voice-overs and more.
It combines the ease-of-use of a “voice memo” audio recorder, with a versatile multi-track editing studio. Powerful tools like effects and automation are available when you need them. With time-saving features and a UI designed to get out of your way, people around the world are switching to Ferrite.
— Streamlined Recording —
Open Ferrite and with just one tap you’re recording. No fuss, and it won't break a sweat even with hours-long sessions. Just make sure your device has enough free space!
Recording an interview and you want to highlight a few quotes? Have to take out some inappropriate language? Or just fluffed a sentence and need to fix it? Bookmark moments during your recording and they’ll be flagged up during edits, so you can jump right to them.
Monitor levels with live recording meters, or listen through headphones. Tag your audio to find it quickly later. And of course you can import audio from your Music Library, iCloud, and other services such as Dropbox.
Please note: the free version has limited duration for recording & editing projects. Upgrade to Pro and you can edit projects up to 24 hours long!
— Editing is a Snip —
Ferrite features full multi-track editing, from quick cuts, to producing a complete podcast or broadcast package. Zoom out to see hours at a glance, or zoom in all the way down to individual samples.
Take a single clip, or a bunch, and arrange them in an editing project: move, crop, slice, fade in and out, or crossfade between clips just by overlapping them. You have full control over each track’s volume and panning, and can Mute or Solo as needed.
And best of all, you needn’t fear trying out changes: Ferrite has great Undo/Redo — even if you quit the app and come back a month later, you can still undo all the way back to the moment you created your project!
— Advanced Features —
Need more? Ferrite also includes:
• Automatic ducking: set tracks to “duck under” others (e.g. ducking music behind voiceovers).
• Strip Silence: Carves away all the silent sections from a recording, making it easy to edit the remaining audio.
• (iPad only) Split View and Slide Over support: Use Ferrite side-by-side with other apps. Recording a narration? Open another app with your script and place Ferrite down the side of the screen. Or open the User Guide in Safari on one side while you learn Ferrite on the other.
With a single In-App Purchase, you can unlock many additional tools, including:
• Preview at up to 2× speed
• Prepare your audio for production with Noise Reduction and Auto Levelling.
• Add professional effects to your tracks such as EQ, Noise Gate and Dynamic Range Compression, for projects that sound clean and engaging.
• Automate volume, panning and effects settings so they vary over time, both on individual tracks and the final mix.
• Tighten Audio can automatically take out awkward pauses and gaps.
• Producing a podcast or series? Create a template to get each new episode off to a flying start.
• Add cover art, chapters and more.
• Found the perfect settings for an effect or tool? Save them as a Preset for re-use in other projects.
• Audio Unit Extensions: if you have other apps installed that provide effects as Audio Unit Extensions, they’ll show up in Ferrite, where you can add them to tracks or projects.
• Advanced search, smart folders, and template folders.

Enter the mysterious arena and challenge formidable opponents. Think through your battle strategies, cleverly utilize items, and defeat enemies one by one to become the ultimate c
bluejetty:00036726:ios.description:
Join Forces with a Little Dinosaur, Pilot Mechas to Victory!
Enter the mysterious arena and challenge formidable opponents. Think through your battle strategies, cleverly utilize items, and defeat enemies one by one to become the ultimate champion. This thrilling adventure offers both challenge and excitement, perfect for kids who love coding games.
Two Gameplay Modes for Continuous Growth
In Adventure Mode, progressively challenge levels and grow with your mecha. In Battle Mode, face randomly matched opponents and strive for consecutive wins. This engaging experience helps kids develop coding skills while enjoying educational games designed for children.
Intuitive Code Blocks Make Learning to Code Easy
Blocks are code, and coding for kids has never been easier. Drag and drop to program your mecha. The colorful graphics make it easy for every child to understand. By arranging and combining blocks, kids can learn coding basics and enhance their computational thinking skills.
8 Themed Arenas with 144 Thrilling Battles
Explore various arenas with unique challenges: hide in the bushes in the forest, slide on icy surfaces in the snow, use conveyor belts for quick movement in the city, and discover more in the base, desert, volcano, and laboratory. Each arena offers a unique environment for logic games and problem-solving.
18 Cool Mechas to Upgrade and Strengthen in Battle
Choose from a variety of mechas: offensive, defensive, and agile types. Each brings a different battle experience. Upgrade your mechas to enhance their attributes and create your ultimate champion. This feature-rich coding game for elementary school children offers hours of fun and learning.
Product Features:
• Graphical Coding Game: Designed specifically for kids, making programming for children fun and intuitive.
• Two Gameplay Modes: Adventure and Battle modes provide endless enjoyment.
• 18 Upgradable Mechas: Each mecha is unique and super cool, perfect for STEM games for kids.
• 8 Themed Arenas: Embark on a journey to become the champion across diverse environments.
• 144 Carefully Selected Levels: Challenge strong opponents and develop coding skills.
• Intelligent Assistance System: Helps kids easily overcome challenges in these educational games.
• Offline Coding Games: Play without needing an internet connection.
• Distraction-Free Experience: No third-party ads, ensuring safe coding games for kids.
This educational app for kids incorporates STEM and STEAM learning principles. It's perfect for coding games for toddlers, preschoolers, and kids aged 5 to 12. With an emphasis on safe, kid-friendly programming, this app is designed to be an educational technology tool that enhances learning through interactive coding games.
Whether your child is learning Scratch for kids, Blockly for kids, or even Python and JavaScript basics, this app makes learning to code fun and accessible. Perfect for beginner coding games, it supports the development of coding skills for kids in a playful, engaging manner.
Discover the ultimate coding adventure with this fun programming game. Download now and let your child embark on a journey of learning and excitement!

* Stay up to date on News and Information Articles related to VRIC

bluejetty:00064203:ios.description:
Son dakika haberleri ile 7/24 yayın yapan sozcu.com.tr, en güncel gazete haberleri ve köşe yazıları ile ücretsiz yayın yapan bir uygulamadır. Ekonomi, dünya, eğitim, magazin, spor, sağlık gibi birçok farklı kategoride içerik üreten haber uygulaması, analizleri ve tarafsız yayın ilkesiyle de rakiplerine fark atıyor. - Yılmaz Özdil, Rahmi Turan, Emin Çölaşan gibi isimlerin yer aldığı Türkiye'nin en iyi yazar kadrosunun köşe yazılarını okuyabilirsiniz.

- Ekonomi haberleri, döviz kurları, altın fiyatları ve finans piyasasını yakından izleyebilirsiniz.
- Canlı skor, maç sonuçları, transfer haberleri, puan durumu ve son dakika spor haberlerinden anında haberdar olabilirsiniz
- Astroloji ve günlük burç yorumlarını Dinçer Güner'in yorumlarıyla okuyabilirsiniz.
- Son dakika magazin haberleri ile beraber, en güncel konser, etkinlik haberlerinin yer aldığı kültür-sanat haberlerine kolaylıkla erişebilir, ayrıca moda, seyahat ve gurme gibi birçok farklı kategoriden de haberdar olabilirsiniz
- Meteoroloji'den yapılan son dakika uyarıları ile birlikte 81 ilin hava durumu raporlarına göz atabilirsiniz.
- Sağlık haberleri kategorisinde uzman doktor yorumlarını ve sağlık alanındaki son gelişmeleri okuyabilirsiniz.
- Sosyal medyada en çok izlenen eğlenceli ve komik videoları izleyebilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00066110:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00066110:ios.description:
This is a Mahjong game of the Japanese style rule.
The Slider that exists under the screen is moved, and the tile is selected. 
And, the Slider is done in the tap and the tile is discard.
Mahjong is the game to finish four Melds and one Pairs.
Example: [1, 2, 3][6, 6, 6][6, 7, 8][N, N, N][4, 4]
However, there is a hand not approved when Chi, Pon, and Open Kan.
Please note whether there is a hand when you do 1 and 9 in Chi and Pon.
In the rule of the japanese mahjong, one or more hands are necessary.
The hand can be made by paying 1,000 points and doing Reach.
However, when Chi, Pon, and Open Kan are done, Reach cannot be done.
If it is a closed hand, high point will be obtained.
About Lost Hand. A hand that is Waiting, but cannot be won off someone else's discard due to the fact that the owner of the hand already threw a winning tile in their own discard.
Lost Hand if one in all winning tiles are here even if discard doesn't do the tile which it wants to do. But, self-draw is possible even with Lost Hand.
The knack is that Ron is never done by the other party.
Ron is never done with the tile that does Discard.
Please reason the Hand from other party's Discard and win.

bluejetty:00040064:ios.description:
EN
N1 is the only news app that you need to stay on top of all happenings in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia and Serbia.
With award-winning news teams in each of the three countries, N1 brings you news as it happens, objectively and professionally.
Use the N1 app to:
• Access the most important news, breaking news, reports, and live updates in no time.
• Get in-depth coverage of relevant news from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia, and Serbia.
Download N1 and never miss the news you need to know.
SR
N1 je jedina informativna aplikacija koja vam je potrebna da budete u toku sa svim događajima u Bosni i Hercegovini, Hrvatskoj i Srbiji.
Sa nagrađivanim novinarskim timovima u sve tri zemlje, N1 vam objektivno i profesionalno donosi vesti sa lica mesta.
Koristite N1 aplikaciju da:
• Brzo i jednostavno pristupite najvažnijim i najnovijim vestima, izveštajima i informacijama koje se ažuriraju svakog trenutka.
• Steknete detaljan uvid u relevantne vesti iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Hrvatske, Slovenije i Srbije.
Preuzmite aplikaciju N1 i nikada ne propustite vesti koje treba da znate.
BH

• Steknete detaljan uvid u relevantne vijesti iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Hrvatske, Slovenije i Srbije.
Preuzmite N1 aplikaciju i nikada ne propustite vijesti koje trebate znati.
SLO
N1 je edina novičarska aplikacija, ki jo potrebujete, da sledite dogajanju v Sloveniji, Bosni in Hercegovini, Srbiji in na Hrvaškem. Naša medijska hiša ima kredibilne novinarske ekipe v vseh omenjenih državah. N1 vam novice prinaša objektivno in profesionalno.
Uporabljajte aplikacijo N1, da boste:
• hitro dostopali do najpomembnejših in izrednih novic, poročanja in dogajanja v živo,
• spremljali poglobljeno pokrivanje pomembnih novic za Slovenijo, Bosno in Hercegovino, Srbijo in Hrvaško.
Prenesite aplikacijo N1 in nikoli ne spreglejte pomembnih novic.

bluejetty:00070241:ios.description:
Welcome to the Flying Unicorn Simulator of your dreams.Step into a magical universe where your unicorn can fly, swim, ride, and take on exciting challenges.From the snowy peaks of Winter Map to the sun-soaked beaches of the Summer Map, there's always an adventure waiting! 
EXPLORE AMAZING WORLDS:
The skies are yours to conquer! Glide through beautiful skies, lush forests, towering mountains, and enchanted castles
Discover exciting maps like Crimson Valley, Sky Island, Tulip Farm, Unicorn Island, and more! Each map offers a unique environment with tons of fun activities, including skiing, water sliding, Ferris wheels and endless adventures.
Take on the Floor is Lava challenge, race your friends, or simply roam the vast, colorful landscapes of the unicorn world!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR UNICORN:
Create the perfect look for you and your unicorn! Customize everything from saddles and wings to horns, eyes, and accessories to design a unicorn that’s truly yours
A UNIVERSE OF UNICORNS
Flying Unicorn Simulator is home to a growing collection of 13 magical unicorn types! Whether you’re flying high with the Star Unicorn, gliding through snow with the Ice Unicorn, or embarking on sweet adventures with the Gingerbread Unicorn, there’s a unicorn for every kind of dream. With more unicorns coming soon, the magic never ends!
ADOPT CUTE PETS:
From dragons to cats, dogs, and penguins, your unicorn will have the perfect companion for every adventure!
JOIN FRIENDS ONLINE:
Ride and Fly with your friends, discover beautiful places together, take on exciting challenges and enjoy the fun of socializing in this magical world.
Challenges, magical events and new unicorns & pets are added regularly. There’s always something new to discover in the magical world of unicorns.
Download now and begin your adventure today!
Premium membership subscription is provided on a monthly basis.
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes account at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
This app offers optional in-app purchases that cost real money. You can disable the in-app purchasing functionality by adjusting your device settings.

bluejetty:00074837:ios.description:
The instax UP!™ smartphone App allows you to scan your instax™ photos that have been printed with a FUJIFILM instax™ instant camera or Smartphone printer and store them digitally.
(1) Scan your instax™ photos
Hold your smartphone over an instax™ mini, SQUARE or WIDE photo when in "Scan" mode to save your instax™ photos, digitally. The instax UP!™ App scans and imports the entire instax™ photo, including the instant film frame.
(2) Collect your instax™ photos, digitally.

bluejetty:00083517:ios.description:
The Nix Toolkit is the new all-in-one companion app for our Nix Sensor device line-up. It’s compatible with all Nix Mini, Nix Pro, Nix QC, and Nix Spectro devices. Functions in the app will be turned on and off depending on which device you have connected.
Functions include:
1. “Single scan” (available for all devices)
2. “Premium databases” (available for all devices)
3. “Create and share custom library (Compatible with Nix Pro, Spectro and QC devices only)
4. “Multipoint average scanning for all tools”
5. "Nix Paints feature"
6. "Nix Quality Control feature"
The “Single scan” function displays digital values (CIELAB, HEX, and RGB) and Spectral curve on swipe (Spectro device only) when you scan a sample with your Nix Color Sensor.
Premium databases offer paid subscriptions to world-class color libraries (including Pantone, RAL, and NCS). Once subscribed you can browse the entire library, and scan and match to the closest color.
The Nix Toolkit app lets you take control of how you perceive color. Select from dark or light mode, or use your own system settings.
If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We’d love to help with whatever questions or issues you have. Please note that a free account is required to use the app (you will be prompted to create one when you first open the app). A Nix device (Mini, Pro, QC, or Spectro) is required to unlock app functions.
Learn more about the Nix Sensor line-up at www.nixsensor.com.
If you find any bugs please contact us directly at info@nixsensor.com and our team will attend to them quickly.
Nix®, Nix Pro™, and Nix Mini™ are trademarks of Nix Sensor Ltd. All other trademarks used herein are simply references to trademarks owned by others and are not intended as trademark use.

Athan Academy brings you an amazing chance to learn Quran from the basics an
bluejetty:00021928:ios.description:
Athan Academy is a one-tap Islamic learning app that helps Muslims perfect their Islamic knowledge through interactive audio and video courses by certified Ulama.
Athan Academy brings you an amazing chance to learn Quran from the basics and then master tajweed to enable you to recite Quran more confidently and fluently with
- Interactive Quran classes
- Quran Tajwid practice exercises
- Direct feedback on your recitation from a Quran teacher
- Flexible learning schedules
- Weekly performance updates
Athan Academy app has been developed by the world's largest online platform for Muslims; Athan and Islamicfinder.org with the help of a team of Islamic Scholars, Qari, Ulama, Mufti and Alim. It contains:
Master Qur’an Tajweed: 
Practice Tajwid rules, Makharij, and how to read Quran fluently with examples of Surahs in video lessons and exercises.
Learn specific techniques from a Qari/Quran teacher to beautify your recitation.
Understand the complete use of Arabic grammar and Quran punctuation.
Interact directly with a Qari/certified Alim in Quran classes to learn Quran flawlessly.
Spiritual Healing Masterclass:
- Learn the six spiritual practices derived from the Quran to manage stress, and strengthen your connection with Allah
- Discover Quran’s teachings for personal growth and improving your physical and mental health
- Practice self-reflection to deepen your relationship with the Quran
Basics to recite Qur’an Tajwid and Makharij from an Arabic Teacher:
- Online Quran Learning / Online Quran Classes with audio and video lessons by an experienced Qari / Ulema
- Quran Arabic with Quran Tajweed and Makharij from a skilled Qari
- Learn the pronunciation of Quran Arabic with the feedback from a certified Alim / Qari
- Quran E-Learning / Online Quran Classes to perfect the art of reciting the Quran in Arabic language by Ulema
- Connected letters in the Arabic language
- Browse Al-Quran through Surahs, Juz and Ayah
- Quran for kids
- Learn Quran Arabic easily with Online Quran lessons exercises / Online Quran Classes
MasterClass for Muslim Teens:
- Understand modern challenges and how to counter them
- Practice your learnings with real life examples
- Connect with your community of peers
How to perform Salat:
- Learn Step by Step Namaz through the video of Salat Guide
- Learn Sunnah Namaz / Salat and how Muslim Prayer is performed
- Easy Namaz guide for kids to learn Salat
How to perform Ablution:
- Learn Step by Step Wudhu through the video of Wudu Guide
- Learn how to perform Ablution according to Sunnah
Other Courses:
- Importance and Etiquettes to read Quran
- Purification of Mind, Body & Soul
- Masnoon Duas every kid and adult Muslim should learn
- A day in the Life of Prophet Mohammad (S.A.W.)
- Essential Basics of Zakat
Athan Academy’s interactive courses are created by a team of Arabic language experts including Islamic scholars, Quran Teacher, Aalim and Ulema.
Paid Courses:
While most courses on Athan Academy are free, some require a one time charge. Below are the charges for the paid courses:
1- Master Tajweed in 4 months = $70
2- Learn to Recite Quran in 12 weeks = $50
3- MasterClass for Muslim Teens = $10
4- Spiritual Healing Masterclass = $15
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
Privacy policy: https://www. islamicfinder.org/athan-academy-privacypolicy/
Terms of use: https://www.islamicfinder.org/terms-of-service-athan-academy/

bluejetty:00074437:ios.description:
Folder Lock lets you password-protect your personal files, photos, videos, documents, contacts, wallet cards, password manager, notes and audios in your iPhone. Apart from being a perfect cross-platform data security app, Folder Lock is a perfect WiFi manager app too, as you can transfer files from your iPhone to PC/Mac, or vice versa, wireless via Folder Lock. Its WiFi Music Manager feature allows you the options of audio import, music import, song import and mp3 import without using iTunes.
Introducing Gallery Lock, which locks your photos and videos. It’s Gallery Lock, Photo Lock and Video Lock options allow you to secure and view your personal photos and videos in their respective windows. In all, this app is the Swiss army knife for smart phone data security and privacy app as well as a perfect file manager. So lock everything with Folder Lock!

bluejetty:00061653:ios.description:
The official iPhone, iPad and Apple TV app for our macOS CCTV software SecuritySpy (securityspy.com). The essential component of a complete video surveillance system for your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, this app allows you to easily monitor and control your camera system from wherever you are.
This iOS app is completely free for registered SecuritySpy users, and also fully functional during the initial trial period. It offers the following features:
- Live video and audio from your cameras
- Multiplex: cycle through groups of simultaneous live camera views in full screen
- Captures: play back recordings, including motion-detected clips, image files or whole-day movies
- Save/share images and recordings via email, iMessage, iCloud Photo Sharing and more
- Picture in Picture: watch a live camera in a floating window over other apps
- Receive push notifications when motion is detected
- PTZ control (Pan, Tilt, Zoom)
- Two-way audio
- Arm or disarm camera recording modes
- Easy setup with auto-discovery of SecuritySpy servers on your network
- View and manage multiple SecuritySpy servers
Please note you will need a Mac running SecuritySpy 5.5.11 or later (securityspy.com), with a license that covers the number of cameras you want to use in the app.
We are always happy to hear your feedback, so please get in touch if you have any suggestions for future updates.

bluejetty:00034128:android.description:

bluejetty:00084799:ios.description:
At Swa:aha (formerly Level SuperMind), we are more than just a meditation, sleep, or astrology app. Swa:aha is your all-in-one wellness companion, designed to help you transform through self-discovery. 
Derived from the Sanskrit "Swa" meaning Self and "Aha" meaning the moment of realization, consider this as your personal OS for a more balanced, mindful life.
We offer personalized solutions for mindful living through daily guided meditation, sleep stories, sleep music, workouts, breathworks, affirmations, and our expert AI coach.
What makes Swa:aha (formerly Level SuperMind) different?
We believe wellness is about you, not just the practice. We act as the facilitators of your journey, providing a warm, thoughtful space and personalized activity recommendations that are easy to follow and flexible to adjust as per your own routine. 
Meditation & Mindfulness:
- 700+ guided and non-guided neuroscience-backed meditations
- 2-minute mindful breathing exercises for relaxation, focus & stress relief
- 40+ Mantra on Lord Bhairav, Shiva, Krishna, and more to reduce anxiety & stress
- Specialized Zodiac Sign Meditation series personalized for you
- 5-minute stress busters, 7-day and 21-day meditation series curated for your needs
- Daily positive affirmations 
Vedic Astrology & Birth Chart
- Your free personalised Kundli (Vedic birth chart) in minutes
- Daily, weekly, and monthly Rashifal rooted in classical Vedic principles
- Zodiac-specific meditations built around your sun and moon signs
- Astrology as a lens to understand yourself, not just predict your week
Sleep Music, meditations & stories:
- Ambient sounds of jazz, nature & space to help you relax and calm
- Bedtime stories for adults and kids, blending ancient Indian mythology and modern techniques
- Sleep Meditation, Yog Nidra & Sleep Courses to build a sleep routine that works for you
- Sleep music and ASMR sounds for a peaceful, uninterrupted sleep
Pranayam, Yoga, and Home Workouts:
- Choose from HIIT, Yoga, Pranayam, and Strength Training sessions
- Range of short 20-minute workout sessions, designed to fit into your busy schedule 
- Relaxing stretches for morning workouts, menstruation, breaks, and pre-sleep routines
Personalized Wellness Journeys:
- Set daily reminders: Stay consistent to build a meditation routine and mindfulness practice
- By understanding your behavior and goals, we suggest the right routine at the right moment
- Save favourites: Keep most-loved wellness activities handy for offline access
Track your progress:
Gently track your wellness journey with our streak, journey, personal AI coach features, and personalized reminders. 
#Why choose Swa:aha (formerly Level SuperMind)?
- Built for India & Beyond. Hindi + English language. Rooted in Vedic, Hindu, and Indian wellness traditions.
- All-in-one. Meditation, sleep, mantra, astrology, workouts. One subscription, no juggling four apps.
- Ad-free. Pay once, breathe easy. No pop-ups between you and your practice.
- For every level. Whether you’re starting your first sadhana or deepening a 10-year practice, you’ll find your pace here.
- Private by design. Your journal, your chart, your journey - all yours alone.
Our Vision:
At Swa:aha (formerly Level SuperMind), we believe that wellness isn’t just about the routine - it’s about YOU.
Our mission is to empower you with personalized tools to build the wellness routine that suits your life. We are the facilitators of your wellness journey. 
Our goal is to help you achieve true mental peace, deep sleep, and an overall balanced life, on your terms.
Subscription Plans:
Unlock exclusive content & advanced features for a fully tailored experience.
Monthly: Rs 299
Half-Yearly: Rs 1249
Annual: Rs 1799
3-Day FREE Trial: Start your wellness journey with a FREE trial and explore everything Swa:aha has to offer.
Read more about our policies here:

bluejetty:00040007:ios.description:
Bán hàng dễ hơn, quản lý nhẹ hơn với Sổ Bán Hàng
- Bán hàng cùng trợ lý AI: Có AI hỗ trợ chăm khách, chốt đơn, nhắc công nợ và giải đáp các việc kinh doanh mỗi ngày.
- Nhanh, dễ dùng: Ứng dụng chạy mượt, thao tác nhanh ngay cả trên những chiếc điện thoại cấu hình không cao. 
- Bắt đầu trong 5 phút: Cài đặt đơn giản, dễ làm quen, không cần mua thêm máy móc hay thiết bị cồng kềnh.
Sổ Bán Hàng giúp bạn quản lý từ A–Z
- Bán hàng nhanh, chốt đơn dễ: Tạo đơn, tính tiền và lưu thông tin khách hàng chỉ với vài thao tác. Dù bán tại cửa hàng hay bán online đều dễ quản lý. 
- Thu tiền, kiểm tra giao dịch dễ dàng: Nhận thanh toán bằng QR và nhiều hình thức khác. Hệ thống tự động cập nhật và thông báo khi khách thanh toán, giúp hạn chế nhầm lẫn và thất thoát. 
- Quản lý hàng hóa, doanh thu rõ ràng: Nhập - xuất kho dễ dàng bằng quét mã. Theo dõi hàng tồn, doanh thu, lãi lỗ và xem báo cáo ngay trên điện thoại. 
- Bán hàng F&B tiện hơn: Dành cho quán ăn, nhà hàng, cà phê với các tính năng gộp bàn, tách đơn, QR gọi món tại bàn, theo dõi món và doanh thu. Nhân viên phục vụ nhanh hơn, chủ quán dễ kiểm soát hơn. 
- Quản lý khách hàng và công nợ: Theo dõi khách hàng, nhắc công nợ, chăm sóc khách và quản lý chương trình khuyến mãi, tích điểm để khách quay lại nhiều hơn. 
Hệ sinh thái tài chính đồng hành
Sổ Bán Hàng còn kết nối với các giải pháp tài chính và ngân hàng, giúp chủ kinh doanh có thêm cơ hội tiếp cận các nguồn vốn phù hợp khi cần mở rộng việc kinh doanh.
Bảo chứng uy tín từ các chuyên gia: Được phát triển bởi đội ngũ chuyên gia công nghệ cấp cao từ Lazada, OPPO, Be Group và các định chế tài chính lớn, Sổ Bán Hàng tự hào được vinh danh qua các giải thưởng danh giá:
- Quán Quân TECHFEST 2022 do Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ tổ chức.
- Giải thưởng từ Asean Startup Innovation Week, Google, MasterCard Strive và BLOCK71.
Tải ngay Sổ Bán Hàng để bán hàng dễ hơn, quản lý nhẹ hơn, phát triển kinh doanh hiệu quả hơn.
Thông tin pháp lý
- Chính sách bảo mật: https://sobanhang.com/chinh-sach-bao-mat/
- Quy chế hoạt động: https://sobanhang.com/quy-che-hoat-dong/
- Điều khoản sử dụng: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00017817:ios.name: Easy Pivot Point
bluejetty:00017817:ios.summary:

Easy Pivot Point automatically calculates and displays pivot levels for major currency pairs, i
bluejetty:00017817:ios.description:
Pivot points are widely used by traders to identify potential support and resistance levels based on the previous period’s high, low and close.
Easy Pivot Point automatically calculates and displays pivot levels for major currency pairs, indices, commodities and exotic instruments, across multiple timeframes in a clean, focused dashboard built for fast decision making.
Whether you are trading ranges, breakouts or monitoring key levels, this app helps you instantly see where price is positioned relative to important pivot zones.
-----------
Why Traders Use Pivot Points
• If price trades above the Pivot Point, sentiment is generally considered bullish
• If price trades below the Pivot Point, sentiment is considered bearish
• Support and resistance levels (S1–S3, R1–R3) often act as reaction zones
• Breaks beyond R3 or S3 may signal strong continuation or exhaustion
Pivot levels are especially popular in the FX market, where many instruments fluctuate within defined ranges.
-----------
What Makes Easy Pivot Point Different
• Real-time dashboard showing where price is trading relative to pivot levels
• Clean summary insight for each instrument (no chart clutter)
• Expandable ladder view showing the nearest two levels around current price
• Smart grouping for faster scanning
• Multi-timeframe support: H1, H4, Daily, Weekly and Monthly
Designed to be fast, focused and distraction-free.
-----------
Alerts That Matter
Subscribers can enable alerts when price interacts with key pivot levels.
• Break above resistance
• Break below support
• Timeframe-specific alerts
• Easily manage alerts per instrument
Premium: Daily alerts
Unlimited: All timeframes
-----------
Important Note
Pivot points are short-term indicators and are most effective within the active trading period of the selected timeframe. They are not long-term forecasting tools.
-----------
Subscription Information
If you choose to subscribe:
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
• You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings
Premium plan: $3.99 USD per month
Unlimited plan: $7.99 USD per month
Prices may vary by country.
Privacy Policy:
http://easyindicators.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use:
http://easyindicators.com/terms.html
-----------
We welcome feedback and suggestions.
Contact us via the in-app support feature or email: support@easyindicators.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/easyindicators
Twitter: @EasyIndicators

bluejetty:00024650:ios.description:
Caught in prison for a crime I didn't commit...
Now, let’s escape without getting caught by the police!
'Super Prison Escape' - What kind of game?
Escape from prison and find the real culprit!
Look for safe places and sometimes team up with fellow prisoners to deceive the eyes of the police officers!
Pick up items around the field and use them in the right places.
You might be able to buy some time and escape by trapping the police officers.
Never give up until the very end!
Because you can take control of your own life!
◆Escape drama with easy controls!◆
First, get items on the field with touch controls.
It's crucial how you use these items to deceive the police officers.
You can use the items you’ve picked up by dragging and dropping them in specific places.
There are many spots in the field where you can perform this action.
If you use them incorrectly, you might get caught by the police again!
Although the prison is a lonely place, there are kind fellow prisoners.
By cooperating with them, you can achieve things that seem difficult at first glance.
What awaits you beyond the thrilling escape drama? What is the identity of the real culprit who framed him?
Play now and witness his fate!

bluejetty:00017084:ios.description:
Download the Triple R app and listen to all your favourite shows anytime, anywhere.
Stream live radio, listen back to previous episodes On Demand, or check out Triple R Recommended content!
For nearly 50 years, Triple R has shaped and inspired the culture of Melbourne/Naarm. Since its inception as an educational broadcaster in 1976, Triple R has become one of Australia’s most influential community radio stations.
Broadcasting on 102.7FM, 3RRR Digital and rrr.org.au, the Triple R grid houses over 70 diverse programs. Music shows cover every genre imaginable from hip hop to punk rock, from R&B and electro to jazz, hip hop, country and metal. Specialist talks programs delve into topics as varied as the environment, politics, science, gardening, film, literature, the arts and local interests.
APP FEATURES
- Live radio on the go, 24/7
- Immediate access to Triple R 102.7FM on your phone
- Tune in to live radio, and catch up on a year’s worth of radio On Demand
- Explore Triple R’s full weekly schedule
- Listen back to previous episodes of your favourite shows
- Explore Triple R Recommends highlights and interviews
- Browse curated collections of our programs
- CarPlay functionality
- Casting to smart devices

Color Splash lets you give photos a dramatic look by converting them to black and white, while keeping your chosen details in color. This effect draws the viewers' attention to the colored areas, creating striking images.
The intuitive and
bluejetty:00016212:ios.description:
Color Splash lets you give photos a dramatic look by converting them to black and white, while keeping your chosen details in color. This effect draws the viewers' attention to the colored areas, creating striking images.
The intuitive and responsive multi-touch user interface makes Color Splash amazingly easy and fun to use. Use your finger as a brush to "paint" sections of your image black and white, or to bring back the original color. Zooming in and out using the two-finger pinching gesture allows you to work on details with pixel-accuracy.
Features:
- Short tutorial videos explain the use of all features and will have you editing your images in minutes.
- Choose photos to edit from your iPhone photo library or from Dropbox or Flickr.
- Save multiple sessions to resume your work later.
- Email your creations to friends, share them on Flickr or save them to your Dropbox.
- Undo any number of accidental brush strokes.
- An alternative view mode highlights the regions that will remain in color with a red tint. This makes it easier to see and adjust the boundaries between color and black & white regions.
- Choose from 4 different brushes (hard or soft edged, opaque or transparent) and adjust the brush size.
- Hide the toolbars in full screen mode.

Color Splash lets you give photos a dramatic look by converting them to black and white, while keeping your chosen details in color. This effect draws the viewers' attention to the colored areas, creating striking images.

The intuitive and responsive multi-touch user interface makes Color Splash amazingly easy and fun to use. Use your finger as a brush to "paint" sections of your image black and white, or to bring back the original color.  Zooming in and out using the two-finger pinching gesture allows you to work on details with pixel-accuracy.

Features:
- Short tutorial videos explain the use of all features and will have you editing your images in minutes.
- Choose photos to edit from your iPhone photo library or from Dropbox or Flickr.
- Save multiple sessions to resume your work later.
- Email your creations to friends, share them on Flickr or save them to your Dropbox.
- Undo any number of accidental brush strokes.
- An alternative view mode highlights the regions that will remain in color with a red tint. This makes it easier to see and adjust the boundaries between color and black & white regions.
- Choose from 4 different brushes (hard or soft edged, opaque or transparent) and adjust the brush size.
- Hide the toolbars in full screen mode.

bluejetty:00073749:ios.summary:
Now there's a simple, elegant and customizable way to get all of the Baltimore Sun's exclusive, premium storytelling on your iPhone and iPad.
FEATURES:
• Stay informed with Baltimore's best source of news, sports, business and entertainme
bluejetty:00073749:ios.description:
Now there's a simple, elegant and customizable way to get all of the Baltimore Sun's exclusive, premium storytelling on your iPhone and iPad.
FEATURES:
• Stay informed with Baltimore's best source of news, sports, business and entertainment
• Sign up for push notifications to get the latest news from our newsroom as soon as stories break
• Enjoy exclusive videos and photo galleries
• Edit the section list to be in your preferred order
• Save must-read stories, photos and videos for when you have the time to enjoy them
• Get the latest breaking news from our newsroom in your notifications
• Share stories easily with Twitter, Facebook, or email
• Offline reading: Download and read content offline
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
• For full access, try one free month of Unlimited Digital Access to the app, the Baltimore Sun website, and our eNewspaper; then it's only $19.99 a month. Make sure to create a registration while in the app so you'll be able to log in to the website and eNewspaper when you visit them in web browsers.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
• Your subscription automatically renews each month unless auto-renew is turned off within your Account Settings at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Your iTunes account will be charged $19.99 for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• You can read our Privacy Policy here: http://www.tribpub.com/privacy-policy/
• You can read our Terms of Service here: http://www.tribpub.com/central-terms-of-service/
• Questions about your subscription, including adding or removing Web access to the Baltimore Sun website from your app access, can be directed to Customer Service: 888-539-1280.
CRASHES / PROBLEMS?
We've been working hard to fix any and all crashes in the app. If you're still experiencing crashes or freezes after installing this update, please contact us at mobile@baltimoresun.com. A quick email to our support team helps our developers identify and resolve crashes faster.

bluejetty:00023224:ios.name: Neural Cloud
bluejetty:00023224:ios.summary:
"Warning! Fatal Error: System integrity severely compromised..."
This is an unprecedented threat to the existence of Dolls. In face of formidable enemies and a future filled with uncertainties, the scattered Dolls grit their teeth and steel
bluejetty:00023224:ios.description:
"Warning! Fatal Error: System integrity severely compromised..."
This is an unprecedented threat to the existence of Dolls. In face of formidable enemies and a future filled with uncertainties, the scattered Dolls grit their teeth and steel themselves as they travel in search of the slim hope of salvation.
Humankind may have abandoned them, but as the person in charge of "Project Neural Cloud", you have steadfastly set foot in this unknown land and founded the "Exiles" as you take in meandering Dolls. With you as their leader, the Exiles shall explore the secrets of the world, find a way out of this desperate situation, and uncover the truth...
「Unique and intricate characters」
Next-gen Dolls from all walks of life await your orders. Seek them out and expand the ranks of the Exiles. Train your favorite Dolls and help them break free of the shackles on their neural clouds. Uncover their hidden pasts... Hush, those are secrets between you and your Dolls.
「Combat that calls for both strength and strategy」
Experience a brand-new combat mode that embodies the essence of roguelike games, with meticulous settings and characterization. Take risks and engage powerful enemies, play it safe and carefully plan your moves with the big picture in mind, or play it by ear and improvise depending on the situation⁠—more than one path leads to victory. Organize your ranks and come up with viable team comps while making good use of friendship buffs, and leave the rest to the Exiles.
「Fun and functional construction system」
Gather materials on your journey to construct and upgrade facilities within the Oasis, the Exiles’ new home. Build a city based on your preferences, upgrade its infrastructure, and construct dormitories to obtain rich resources and powerful buffs. May you and your beloved Dolls enjoy a brief respite before you set off on your next adventure.

Unlock your artistic potential with Donny! Turn all your ideas into breathtaking AI art in seconds. Enter a prompt, pick a style, and watch the magic unfold!

bluejetty:00033472:ios.name: To The Trenches: WW1 Army RTS
bluejetty:00033472:ios.summary:
Command a WW1 army in pixel-art trench warfare. Send infantry over the top, call in artillery and gas strikes to dominate the front lines.
Real-time strategy that can be played fully offline, with a large roster of nations, changing weather
bluejetty:00033472:ios.description:
Command a WW1 army in pixel-art trench warfare. Send infantry over the top, call in artillery and gas strikes to dominate the front lines.
Real-time strategy that can be played fully offline, with a large roster of nations, changing weather and an endless campaign where no two battles are alike.
Free to play with no ads of any kind. One purchase unlocks every nation, skill and elite units.
Lead your army through the chaos of 1917 Trench Warfare in this retro-style military strategy game. Command infantry, deploy brutal artillery strikes and dominate the battlefield with tactical precision. Procedurally generated battles mean every fight offers new challenges.
▶ FEATURES ◀
[PROCEDURAL BATTLES]
- Procedurally generated battlefields, so no two wars are alike.
- Face dilemmas that can change morale, rewards and your troops' stats.
[SPECIALIZED UNITS]
- Unlock, upgrade and deploy Sharpshooters, Flame Troopers, Sentries, Trench Raiders and Medics.
- Call in artillery, and with Unlimited add Tanks, Armored Vehicles, Mortar Teams and Strafing Runs.
- Grow your army through the in-depth Officer Tree and your platoon officers.
[AUTHENTIC WW1 SETTING]
- Detailed pixel art shows the brutality of trench warfare.
- Fight through mud, and with Unlimited, lightning storms, blizzards and sandstorms that change your tactics.
[UNIQUE FACTIONS]
- Play Germany, France, Britain or Austria-Hungary for free. Every nation has two faction perks that change how it fights.
[OFFLINE FRIENDLY]
- Battles play without an internet connection.
▶ WHAT'S FREE ◀
- Procedurally generated battles, artillery, mud and platoon officers
- Most of the Officer Tree
- Germany, France, Britain and Austria-Hungary
- Seasonal events
- No intrusive ads
▶ WHAT UNLIMITED ADDS ◀
One purchase, no subscription, unlocks:
- More nations: Italy, Ottoman Empire, Russia, the USA, Canada, Bulgaria and Serbia
- Tanks and armored vehicles
- Specialists: Sharpshooters, Flame Troopers, Sentries, Trench Raiders and Medics
- Grenades, Mortar Teams and Strafing Runs
- Weather: lightning storms, blizzards and sandstorms
- Daily, weekly and monthly missions
Command. Adapt. Survive.
Do you have what it takes to lead your army to victory? Enlist now and head To The Trenches!

bluejetty:00075595:ios.description:
When your sister has strange dreams about a mysterious amulet tied to your long-lost grandfather, you both set out for Ireland to investigate! But what you find is beyond anything you could have imagined. A group of magical beings want your family’s amulet, and they’ll stop at nothing to get it! But are the Seeds the villains they’re painted out to be, or are even darker forces at play? It’s up to you to find out in this otherworldly Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

• Solve intuitive mini-games, brain teasers, & unique puzzles.
• Explore 40+ stunning locations.
• Spectacular graphics!
• Assemble collections, seek & find morphing objects.

bluejetty:00042108:ios.description:
Get a second number for business and personal calls and SMS! 
Second number on your iPhone. A virtual number instead of a real one is useful for protecting privacy. Separate your personal life and work. 
The WeCall app is great for announcements, dating, travel and business, registration in online services, ordering a taxi or booking and rental services.
CALLS AND SMS
Using the application, you can purchase a virtual number, receive and make calls, send and receive messages and images.
REAL SECOND PHONE NUMBER
The number works without purchasing a SIM card, without concluding contracts with operators.
You can also use a second number to securely separate work and personal communications and protect your privacy from spam.We provide virtual numbers in the United States, you can choose any region and state, depending on your need.
CHEAP APP FOR CALLING AND TEXTING MESSAGES
You can use a second number over 3G/4G/5G/WIFI to save money on phone calls. We provide access to international phone calls and SMS at low prices.Sending messages may be limited depending on the country or type of number to which messages are sent.
CREDIT PACKAGE
If the credits included in the subscription are not enough for you, you can always purchase additional packages with credits for 100, 500, 1000 or 2000 credits.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
For your convenience, we have made several plans: from a weekly subscription to a 6-month subscription. When you subscribe, we assign you a number of your choice, which is assigned to you for the entire duration of your subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.
IMPORTANT
Take full responsibility when using virtual numbers. Do not use numbers for fraudulent purposes, spam, scam or other illegal activities.
If you have any question/problem/suggestion for the second number app, feel free to contact us hello@wecallapp.com
Terms of Use: https://api.wecallapp.com/tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://api.wecallapp.com/policy.html

bluejetty:00034027:ios.description:
Ready for a word-guessing challenge? 
PixelPhrase ™ Guess The Word is here to elevate your experience! Forget the easy 4 pics or 2 pictures riddles—now guess the word from just one image. Challenge yourself with the ultimate AI-generated pictures in this word puzzle!
This word-brain game offers hundreds of levels with eye-catching images created by artificial intelligence. Guess the word from a wide variety of unique puzzles and enjoy this word challenge daily!
How to Play: 
Guess the word from the pic! Each level features a unique AI-generated picture, and you need to type the correct word to solve the puzzle.
For example:
- Milk bottles shaking hands? The word is "milkshake."
- A worm in a book? The word is "bookworm."
Challenge your skills and enjoy hundreds of exciting levels in this pic-to-word game!
Game Features:
- Hundreds of unique images with new ones added regularly.
- Perfect for both adults and kids.
- Use power-ups to reveal letters, disable unused letters, and get hints when you’re stuck.
- Pics-based challenges that test your word-guessing skills.
Challenge your friends with these unique pic word riddles and become the top word-guessing master!

bluejetty:00022225:ios.description:
The fastest way to set reminders and persistent, nagging alarms. Perfect for habits, medication, and staying on track without the clutter of a calendar.
Tired of forgetting important tasks or appointments? Beep Me is the reminder app designed to help you manage your schedule effortlessly. Whether it’s setting a quick reminder or one that keeps nagging you until you act, Beep Me has you covered with just a couple of taps.
Imagine this:
You’re in a meeting and remember you promised to call Jack later. Quickly note “Call Jack” and set a reminder for 2:30 PM. Or, you’ve got a pizza in the oven and need a timer for 20 minutes? Beep Me makes it easy to set reminders in seconds without the hassle of complicated apps or calendar clutter.
Key Features:
◆ Nagging Mode: Never miss a reminder again! Set how often and how many times Beep Me should nag you until you act.
◆ Quick Setup: Create reminders in seconds using either timer-style (e.g., “Remind me in 20 minutes”) or clock-style (e.g., “Remind me at 2:30 PM”).
◆ Repeat Reminders: Customize daily, weekly, monthly, or custom intervals to fit your schedule.
◆ Apple Watch Integration: View, snooze, or mark reminders as done straight from your wrist when a reminder pops up.
◆ Customizable Sounds & Widgets: Choose your preferred notification sounds and add widgets to your home screen for quick access to reminders.
◆ Beep Priority: Set High priority to break through Focus modes, or Urgent to sound alarms even in Silent mode.
What Users Are Saying:
◆ "This app is a game-changer. The nagging reminders mean I never forget anything!"
◆ "Quick, intuitive, and exactly what I needed to stay on top of my tasks."
Ready to stay on top of your schedule? Download Beep Me today and experience a life with fewer forgotten tasks and more peace of mind!

bluejetty:00069647:ios.summary:
3D mapping, reconstruction, and visual positioning from Niantic Spatial
Scaniverse captures, reconstructs, and localizes physical environments — on your phone, and now in the cloud. It’s a foundation for AR, robotics, spatial computing, co
bluejetty:00069647:ios.description:
3D mapping, reconstruction, and visual positioning from Niantic Spatial
Scaniverse captures, reconstructs, and localizes physical environments — on your phone, and now in the cloud. It’s a foundation for AR, robotics, spatial computing, construction planning, and other apps and workflows that require high-fidelity 3D digital twins.
Capture: Point your phone at any space and turn it into 3D data.
- Scan spaces indoors and out, from a single room to a warehouse
- Works with your mobile device’s cameras and sensors
- Combine scans from multiple users and devices into one unified site project
Reconstruct: Process scans into detailed, responsive 3D images.
- State-of-the-art cloud processing turns your scans into immersive Gaussian splats for planning and simulations
- Precise meshes for robotics simulation and collision geometry
- Export in SPZ, PLY, GLB and FBX
Localize: Test Niantic VPS 2.0 in app, deploy with NSDK.
- Better than GPS everywhere, precise where you've mapped. 
- Works indoors, in urban canyons, and GPS-denied environments
- Integrate via NSDK 4.0 for Unity, Swift, and Kotlin
Accounts: Free tier for personal scanning and testing, with limited cloud processing and multi-user collaboration. Paid plans unlock more processing, bigger teams, 360° camera scans, and enterprise support.
Still the world's best free 3D scanner: The classic Scaniverse experience you know is still here — unlimited on-device Gaussian splat capture and processing, several export formats including SPZ, and the shared global map. Nothing's changed. 
Scaniverse is built on the legacy of 25 years of geospatial innovation, including Google Earth and Google Maps. It’s the gateway to Niantic Spatial’s Large Geospatial Model, which builds on the same mission of making the world navigable and understandable, this time through a spatial AI for machines.
Learn more: scaniverse.com
Terms of use: scaniverse.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.nianticspatial.com/privacy-consumer and scaniverse.com/privacy

bluejetty:00064329:ios.description:
Watch web-videos, online-movies, livestreams and live-tv shows and your personal photos, videos & music by using Google Cast on your Sony TV, Vizio SmartCast TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Toshiba TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player or Nvidia Shield gaming console. Enjoy the show on your big screen.
With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Google Cast enabled device (movies, tv shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and send the embedded video with a single tap to your TV or gaming console. The discovered video will be shown below the browser. A tap on the video link will send it to your Google Cast enabled device immediately. Streaming personal media from your device is also supported.
* The app only works with devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, like Vizio TV, Toshiba TV, Sony TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player, Nvidia Shield gaming console
* iTunes movies, Flash video and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported!
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming.
